concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 7 Science ke Chapter 17 — अपशिष्ट जल की कहानी — ko samjhenge. Is chapter mein hum seekhenge ki ghar, school aur industry se nikalne wala ganda pani wastewater/sewage kaise banta hai; usme kaun-kaun si ashuddhiyan hoti hain; sewer system se treatment plant tak uski journey; aur physical-chemical-biological prakriyaon se uska shuddhikaran kaise hota hai. Saath hi hum seekhenge ki jaagrook nagrik ban kar ghar ki naliyon aur swachhta se bimariyon ko kaise rok sakte hain.
concept_map.welcome: Good morning, bacchon! Aaj ek simple sawaal se shuru karte hain — jab tum subah brush karte ho, bartan dhote ho, ya toilet use karte ho, toh woh pani kahaan jaata hai? Foamy, oily, kaala-bhura pani sink aur naliyon se nikalta hai — isi ko hum अपशिष्ट जल ya wastewater kehte hain. Aaj Smart Board par hum iski poori kahani padhenge, bilkul jaise ek teacher class mein samjhate hain. Ready ho? Chalo shuru karte hain!
learning_outcomes: अपशिष्ट जल और वाहित मल (sewage) की परिभाषा समझना तथा स्वच्छ जल के उपयोग व कमी की गंभीरता बताना
वाहित मल में कार्बनिक-अकार्बनिक अशुद्धियाँ, पोषक तत्त्व, जीवाणु और अन्य सूक्ष्मजीवों को पहचानना
सीवर तंत्र, मेनहोल और अपशिष्ट जल उपचार संयंत्र के मुख्य चरण (बार स्क्रीन, ग्रिट टंकी, आपंक, वातन, क्लोरीनीकरण) समझाना
अच्छी गृह व्यवस्था, जागरूक नागरिक व्यवहार और स्वच्छता–रोग के संबंध को दैनिक जीवन में लागू करना

generated.concept: अपशिष्ट जल क्या है और स्वच्छ जल क्यों ज़रूरी है
generated.say: Bacchon, hum sab apne ghar mein jal ka use karte hain — peene, nahaane, kapde dhone, bartan saaf karne ke liye. Lekin use ke baad hum usi pani ko ganda ya dooshit bana dete hain. Dooshit? Kya aascharya hua? Dekho — jhaag se bharpoor, tel mila hua, kaala ya bhura rang ka pani jo sink, shauchalaya, laundry se naaliyon mein jaata hai — yahi अपशिष्ट जल ya wastewater kehlata hai. Important: is tarah ke kaamon mein prayukt jal ko vyarth nahi jaane dena chahiye. Humein dooshit padarth hataakar use swachch banana chahiye. Kabhi socha hai wastewater kahaan jaata hai aur uska kya hota hai? Yeh chapter yahi mystery solve karega. Swachch jal manushyon ki मूलभूत आवश्यकता hai. Chitra 13.1 mein vrttakar khali sthanon mein swachch jal ke upyog likho — jaise peyjal. Tum aur bhi jod sakte ho: kheti, safai, cooking, industry. Durbhagya se upyog ke liye upyukt swachch jal sabko available nahi. Ek report ke anusar ek arab se adhik logon ko surakshit peyjal nahi milta. Iske kaaran vishwa ki bahut badi jansankhya jal-sambandhi bimariyon se peedit rehti hai aur kai log mrityu ka grās ban jaate hain. Kai ilakon mein log, yahan tak ki bacche, swachch jal laane ke liye kai kilometre paidal chalte hain. Kya yeh manav garima ke liye gambheer samasya nahi hai? Aaj ka pehla message: clean water precious hai, aur wastewater ko samajhna uski raksha ka pehla kadam hai.

generated.concept: जल की सफाई और जीवन के लिए जल दशक
generated.say: Ab thoda badi picture dekhte hain, bacchon. Tumhe pata hoga ki jansankhya vriddhi, pradushan, audyogik vikas, kuprabandhan aur anya karakon ke kaaran alavan ya taze jal ki supply mein kami badh rahi hai. Sthiti ki gambheerata samajhte hue, World Water Day — 22 March 2005 — ko United Nations General Assembly ne 2005–2015 ki avadhi ko 'जीवन के लिए जल' / Water for Life International Decade ke roop mein ghoshit kiya. Is decade ke sabhi prayason ka uddeshya un vyaktiyon ki sankhya ko ghataakar aadha karna tha, jinhhe surakshit peyjal uplabdh nahi hai. Bahut prayas hue, lekin abhi bhi bahut kuch baaki hai. Ab important definition: जल की सफाई karne ke prakram mein jal ke sroton mein pravesh athava uske punah-upyog se pehle usmein se pradushakon ko alag karna shamil hai. Apashisht jal ke upchaar ko samanya roop se वाहित मल उपचार / sewage treatment kehte hain. Yeh anek charanon mein sampann hota hai — aage hum step-by-step padhenge. Simple language mein: dirty water ko seedha nadi mein nahi phenkna; pehle pollutants alag karo, tab reuse ya release. Yeh cleaning process physical, chemical aur biological teen tarah ki prakriyaon se hota hai — baad ke concepts mein detail aayegi. Class tip: jab bhi exam mein 'Water for Life' aaye, saal 2005–2015 aur lakshya 'aadha karna' yaad rakho. Aur yeh bhi yaad rakho — cleaning of water = pollutants hataana before water goes back to sources or is reused.

generated.say: Ab definitions clear karte hain. वाहित मल ya sewage kya hai? Yeh gharo, udyogon, aspatalon, karyalayon aur anya upyogon ke baad pravahit kiya jaane wala apashisht jal hota hai. Ismein varsha-jal bhi shamil hai, jo tez varsha ke samay galiyon mein bahta hai. Sadkon aur chhaton se bahkar aane wala varsha-jal apne saath hanikarak padarth le aata hai — isliye rainwater jo streets se dirty hokar aata hai, sewage ka hissa ban sakta hai. Sewage द्रवरूपी अपशिष्ट hota hai. Ismein adhikansh जल hota hai, jismein ghule hue aur nilambit apadravya hote hain — matlab dissolved aur suspended impurities. Activity 13.2: apne ghar, school ya sadak par kisi khuli naali ko dekho. Usmein bahte sewage/water ka nirikshan karo — rang, gandh aur anya avalokan note karo. Friends aur teacher se charcha karke Table 13.1 mein likho: वाहित मल का प्रकार, उत्पत्ति स्थल, संदूषक पदार्थ, कोई अन्य टिप्पणी. Book examples: kitchen se jhaghda/karkat-malin jal, shauchalaya se durgandhyukt apashisht, audyogik sansthan se vyavasayik apashisht. Safety tip: naali ke paas jaakar chhoona mat, sirf door se observe karo. Yaad rakho — sewage complex mixture hai, sirf 'ganda pani' bolna kaafi nahi; ismein suspended solids, organic-inorganic ashuddhiyan, nutrients, saprophytes, disease-causing bacteria aur anya microbes hote hain. Agla concept in impurities ki detail dega.

generated.concept: वाहित मल में अशुद्धियाँ और संदूषक
generated.say: Bacchon, ab sewage ke andar jhaankte hain. Hum jaante hain ki वाहित मल एक जटिल मिश्रण hota hai. Ismein nilambit thos, carbonic aur acarbonic ashuddhiyan, poshak tatva, mritajeevi (saprophytes) aur rog-vahak jeevanu tatha anya sukshma-jeev hote hain. Book ke examples yaad rakho. कार्बनिक अशुद्धियाँ: manav mal, jaivik apashisht padarth, tel, urea (mootra), peedaknashak, shaaknashak, phal aur sabji ka kachra. अकार्बनिक अशुद्धियाँ: nitrate, phosphate, dhatuyen. पोषक तत्त्व: phosphorus aur nitrogen yukt padarth. जीवाणु: cholera aur typhoid jaise rog utpann karne wale — Vibrio cholerae aur Salmonella typhi. अन्य सूक्ष्मजीव: pechish aadi rog utpann karne wale protozoa. Simple tip for class: organic = living/once-living related wastes (mal, oil, food); inorganic = salts aur metals; nutrients = N aur P; pathogens = bimari failane wale microbes. Yeh impurities isliye dangerous hain kyunki agar sewage bina treatment ke nadi/talab mein chala jaaye toh peene ka pani aur mahaul dono kharab ho sakte hain. Table 13.1 ke columns — प्रकार, उत्पत्ति स्थल, संदूषक — isi classification se jude hain. Exam mein aksar list poochhi jaati hai: organic vs inorganic examples. Cholera-typhoid ke bacteria names bhi yaad rakhne layak hain. Kabhi impurities ko 'sirf mitti' mat samajhna — chemical aur biological contaminants bhi hote hain.
generated.example: Kitchen ka sabzi-kachra aur cooking oil organic impurities hain; detergent/fertilizer se aaye phosphate-nitrate inorganic/nutrient type contamination badha sakte hain.

Mal vyavastha mein मेनहोल samanyatah prati 50 se 60 metre ki doori par, do athava adhik sewers ke sandhisthal par, athava jahaan disha mein parivartan hota hai, wahan hote hain. Activity 13.3: ghar/school/public building se sewage ke path ka adhyayan karo — (i) path ka rekhachitra banao, (ii) gali-sadak mein ghoomkar manholes ki sankhya maloorn karo, (iii) kisi khule naale ke ird-gird kaun-se sajeew jeev panap rahe hain, unki suchi banao. Agar aas-paas sewerage system na ho, toh pata karo sewage ka nibtaan kaise hota hai. Yaad rakho: clean-water pipes aur sewage pipes alag networks hain — mix nahi hone chahiye. Manhole cleaning dangerous ho sakti hai, isliye bacche kabhi manhole kholkar andar nahi jhaanken. Yeh section journey samjhata hai — treatment plant ke steps agle concepts mein aayenge.

generated.say: Ab asal Wastewater Treatment Plant / अपशिष्ट जल उपचार संयंत्र. Ismein physical, chemical aur biological prakriyaen hoti hain jo contaminants alag karti hain. Step 1: Bar screen / शलाका छन्ना — oordhvakar chadon wala screen. Kapde ke tukde, dandiyaan, dibbe, plastic packets, napkins jaise bade contaminants ruk jaate hain. Step 2: Grit and sand removal tank — pani dheere flow karta hai, baalu-grit-kankad pendi mein baith jaate hain. Step 3: Badi tank jiska penda beech ki taraf dhalan wala; kai ghanton baad mal jaise thos baithte hain — आपंक / sludge; scrape karke nikaalte hain. Tealne wale tel-grease skimmer / अपमथित्र se hatate hain. Aisa saaf pani निर्मलीकृत जल / clarified water kehlata hai. Sludge alag tank mein anaerobic bacteria se toot'ta hai; biogas banti hai — fuel ya electricity ke liye. Step 4: Clarified water mein hawa guzarte hain — aerobic bacteria badhte hain aur bache human waste, food waste, soap wagairah khaa jaate hain. Kai ghanton baad microbes activated sludge banakar baithte hain; upar ka pani nikaalte hain. Activated sludge ~97% water; drying beds/machines se sukhaakar खाद banate hain — nutrients mitti mein wapas. Treated water samudra, nadi ya bhoomi mein ja sakta hai; prakritik prakriyaen aur saaf karti hain. Kabhi chlorine ya ozone se roganu-rahit karna padta hai. Nadi bhi naturally similar processes se pani saaf karti hai. Eucalyptus tip: WWTP ke aas-paas eucalyptus extra wastewater absorb karke shuddh jal-vaashp chhod sakte hain.
